# Product Design

> **📋 DOCUMENTATION RULES FOR AI ASSISTANTS**
>
> **Document Type**: Tier 2 Reference Document (never archive; update as the design changes)
> **Purpose**: How [PROJECT_NAME] behaves - the product spec, as current truth. Optional: for products with user-facing or agent behaviour
> **Update Frequency**: When a behaviour is added or changed
>
> **When editing this document**:
> - ✅ Write each rule once, as current truth, in the section that owns it; link to it from elsewhere
> - ✅ Say where each behaviour lives - a rule in code, a field a model outputs, or judgment in a prompt, which needs evals
> - ✅ A choice someone will want to reverse is a key decision in [`05_DESIGN-DECISIONS.md`](../05_DESIGN-DECISIONS.md); cite it from the section it shapes
> - ✅ A change to a rule a scenario shows updates the scenarios in the same change, and regenerates any rendered view
> - ✅ Close an open question by writing the answer into its section, or by a key decision
> - ❌ Don't keep a history of how the design got here - session docs and the decision log's archive hold it
> - ❌ Don't track tasks here (use `03_TODO.md` and the session doc)
>
> **Full Documentation System**: [docs/00_ONBOARDING.md](../00_ONBOARDING.md)
